FarmerProfile.title: FarmerProfile
FarmerProfile.description: Persistent profile, workshop step, vertical rack configuration, deployed hydroponic tiers, and El Nino drought resilience metrics for a student farmer.

farmerKey.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex digest derived from normalized farmerName and passcode.

farmerName.description: Display name chosen by the learner.

activeZone.description: Current area the farmer is standing in.

kitchenStep.description: Current fabrication step inside the kitchen workshop.

rackSize.description: Selected vertical rack stand capacity (1 to 6 garden racks / PVC pipe tiers).

tiers.description: Bounded list (max 6) of deployed PVC tiers, planted crop IDs, and planting/watering timestamps.

totalHarvestedCount.description: Total number of crops harvested across sessions.

jojoInstalled.description: Whether the farmer has crafted the outdoor JoJo rainwater harvesting tank.

jojoLitres.description: Remaining stored water in litres inside the JoJo rainwater tank.

jojoCapacity.description: Maximum storage capacity in litres of the JoJo rainwater tank.

shadeClothInstalled.description: Whether the 40% agricultural shade-cloth canopy is installed over the vertical rack.

windbreakInstalled.description: Whether woven agricultural windbreak netting is deployed around the garden rack.

stormBraceInstalled.description: Whether storm anchor straps and the JoJo gutter diverter are latched for heavy rain.

weatherMode.description: Current simulated El Nino / real-time weather forecast phase.

litresSaved.description: Cumulative water saved in litres compared to conventional open-soil gardening.

foodServings.description: Total fresh household food servings produced from harvested tiers.

door3DripBottleType.description: Selected 2L bottle variant for Door 3 Workstation 1.

door3CompostContainer.description: Selected composter container (bucket, crate, or pallet) for Door 3 Workstation 2.

door3CompostRejectTested.description: Number of non-compostable avoid items inspected in Workstation 2 (0 to 4).

door3MulchMaterial.description: Selected mulch shield material (cardboard or newspaper) for Door 3 Workstation 3.

schoolName.description: Free-text school name entered by the learner.

schoolKey.description: Trimmed, lowercased school identifier for matching parent and student records.

teacherName.description: Optional teacher name entered by the learner.

compostYieldsSinceRefresh.description: Count of crop harvests since the student last refreshed Door 3 compost.

bestCompetitionMs.description: Fastest speed-run elapsed milliseconds recorded when Admin competition timer is enabled.

builtRacks.description: Bounded list (max 6) of assembled garden racks with material choice, recyclability flag, co-op builder name, and build timestamp.

ecoBuilderPoints.description: Cumulative Eco-Builder bonus points awarded for assembling garden racks with recyclable materials.

solarStep.description: Room 4 Solar & PVC Workshop step progress (1 to 5).

solarFrameParts.description: Number of Step 1 elevated PVC mounting frame parts snapped (0 to 4).

solarPanelParts.description: Number of Step 2 solar panel assembly parts locked (0 to 3).

solarWiringMode.description: Selected solar wiring topology (series for voltage or parallel for amperage).

solarWiredStage.description: Sequential Step 3 wiring completion stage (0 to 4).

solarTiltDeg.description: Mounted solar panel tilt angle in degrees (0 to 75).

solarAzimuthDeg.description: Mounted solar panel horizontal rotation angle in degrees (-90 to 90).

solarDustLevel.description: Simulated El Nino dust accumulation overlay on solar panels (0 to 100).

yieldsSinceSolarClean.description: Harvest yield counter since the last Room 4 solar panel wash and angle check.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when farmer profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest saved state.

ParentProfile.title: ParentProfile
ParentProfile.description: Persistent profile for a parent or sponsor linked to a normalized schoolKey and one or more learner grades.

parentKey.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex digest derived from normalized parent pseudonym and passcode.

pseudonym.description: Pseudonym chosen by the parent or sponsor.

schoolName.description: Free-text school name entered by the parent or sponsor.

schoolKey.description: Trimmed, lowercased school identifier matching student schoolKey records.

grades.description: Bounded list (1 to 9) of Grade 4 to Grade 12 selections for children at the school.

adoptedPets.description: Bounded list (max 4) of adopted South African herbivore sanctuary companions with happiness, hunger, water, energy, and play meters.

walletBalanceZar.description: Parent/sponsor Karri credit wallet balance in ZAR.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when parent profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest saved state.

UserAccount.title: UserAccount
UserAccount.description: Standardized unified user profile bridging existing farmer/parent profiles, Karri credit wallet balance, and owned indigenous pets.

StoreListing.title: StoreListing
StoreListing.description: Real-time storefront listing fed by student crop harvests, Door 3 mulch/compost batches, and pet care supply bundles.

StudentGrow.title: StudentGrow
StudentGrow.description: Active student garden crop or Door 3 compost/mulch cycle currently growing toward harvest (On Its Way visibility).

HarvestBatch.title: HarvestBatch
HarvestBatch.description: Immutable student harvest event used for live store stock replenishment and rolling 14-day student harvest scores.

StoreOrder.title: StoreOrder
StoreOrder.description: Completed atomic checkout order paid via Karri Credit Wallet delivering care/supply boosts to a sanctuary pet.

WalletTopup.title: WalletTopup
WalletTopup.description: Karri minimum R250 wallet credit top-up transaction.

AdminMeta.title: AdminMeta
AdminMeta.description: Singleton bootstrap status indicating whether the primary Admin account has been claimed.

AdminAccount.title: AdminAccount
AdminAccount.description: Admin profile keyed by deterministic SHA-256 digest of normalized adminName and passcode.

AdminWriteToken.title: AdminWriteToken
AdminWriteToken.description: Write-only atomic Admin action proof token linking an authenticated adminKey to an Admin mutation.

SystemConfig.title: SystemConfig
SystemConfig.description: Admin-controlled global challenge settings including Competition Speed Timer toggle, compost refresh cycle limit, and intermittent stage-targeted banners.

solarDustYieldTriggerLimit.description: Crop yields required before El Nino solar dust maintenance is triggered (1 to 10, default 3).

maxHarvestHoursCap.description: Maximum allowed harvest cycle cap in hours (12 to 24).

banners.description: Up to 12 stage-targeted intermittent banners (scroll or flash).

AdminDocument.title: AdminDocument
AdminDocument.description: Document or guide uploaded by an Admin for students and parents to view and download.

CompetitionRun.title: CompetitionRun
CompetitionRun.description: Speed-run completion record logged when Admin enables Competition Timer mode.

LeaderboardStudent.title: LeaderboardStudent
LeaderboardStudent.description: Public-safe student harvest ranking projection synced on login, progress save, and harvest.

GradeSaleEvent.title: GradeSaleEvent
GradeSaleEvent.description: Append-only public-safe sale event recorded atomically on store checkout for per-school and per-grade sales totals.

SponsorSlot.title: SponsorSlot
SponsorSlot.description: Admin-assigned sponsor branding slot mapped to a room (kitchen, garden, compost, platform), prop/panel target, display mode (text, logo, or both), and optional compressed image data URL.

/farmers/{farmerKey}.description: Stores each farmer's persistent kitchen fabrication progress, vertical rack size, timestamped tier crops, compost yield cycle counters, and El Nino drought resilience metrics.

/parents/{parentKey}.description: Stores each parent or sponsor pseudonym, normalized schoolKey, selected grade list, wallet balance, and adopted sanctuary pets.

/users/{uid}.description: Standardized unified user profile bridging farmer/parent records, Karri walletBalanceZar, and owned sanctuary pets.

/store_listings/{listingId}.description: Live store shelf inventory fed by student harvests and pet care supply bundles.

/student_grows/{growId}.description: Active student crops and Door 3 compost/mulch batches growing toward harvest for On Its Way visibility.

/harvest_batches/{batchId}.description: Student harvest log for stock attribution and 14-day rolling harvest scorecards.

/store_orders/{orderId}.description: Atomic store orders paid from Karri Credit Wallet.

/wallet_topups/{topupId}.description: Minimum R250 Karri wallet credit top-up logs.

/admin_meta/{docId}.description: Singleton bootstrap lock indicating whether the primary Admin account is claimed.

/admins/{adminKey}.description: Admin records keyed by SHA-256 digest of admin name and passcode.

/admin_write_tokens/{tokenId}.description: Write-only atomic Admin action tokens verified via getAfter() during admin mutations.

/system_config/{configId}.description: Global Admin settings for Competition Timer toggle and compost redo yield limit.

/admin_documents/{docId}.description: Admin-uploaded guides, rules, and challenge documents.

/competition_runs/{runId}.description: Fastest completion leaderboard runs logged during active Competition Timer mode.

/leaderboard_students/{studentUid}.description: Public-safe student leaderboard entries enabling Student and Parent cross-school harvest rankings without listing private /farmers docs.

/grade_sale_events/{saleId}.description: Append-only anonymized sale telemetry written during atomic store checkout for live school and per-grade sales aggregation.

/sponsor_slots/{slotId}.description: Modular sponsor brand slots across Kitchen, Garden, Compost, and Platform surfaces managed via Admin write tokens.
